thread:
maria: Ok team — finalizing a webinar idea: ‘Session Economy: Making LLM demos production-safe’. Goal: show concrete tradeoffs (latency, cost, reliability), a short benchmark narrative, and a live failover demo. Proposed date: May 10. Draft abstract below — open to edits.

maria: Draft abstract: We’ll walk through how to run low-latency, cost-effective LLM demos at scale: measurement strategy, practical batching/caching knobs, quantization tradeoffs, and an ops-first failover that keeps demos online during pressure. Includes a short live demo + simulated outage + automatic fallback. Audience: engineering/product folks evaluating inference for customer-facing features.

dan: love it. good audience. +1 to making the failover the hook; that’s the thing buyers remember.

sofia: I can own the live demo and the failover script if that helps. availability: May 3-9 flexible afternoons PT.

lee: I’ll own the benchmark narrative and slides — want to keep it simple: p50, p95, cost / 1k tokens, and a single slide comparing batching+cache+quantization.

maria: perfect — proposed speaker split: intro + product story (me), benchmark (lee), demo + failover (sofia). dan you run host/QA?

dan: yep I can host / moderate. will prep 3-4 seed Qs. :thumbsup:

lee: quick ask — can we include an interactive poll during the session: "What's the biggest constraint for your team? (latency/cost/reliability)". keeps it engaged and ties to the demo.

maria: yes. add a 60s poll after benchmarks.

sofia: needed from everyone: a 1-paragraph speaker note and 3 test prompts for the demo. sample prompts below I’ll use for smoke tests: 
- "Summarize this product doc in 3 bullets"
- "Rewrite this email to be more concise and action oriented"
- "Given logs X, Y, Z, suggest next investigation steps"

maria: run-of-show (draft):
```
00:00 - Welcome + goal (maria) 5m
05:00 - Product narrative: why session economy matters (maria) 8m
13:00 - Benchmarks & takeaways (lee) 10m
23:00 - Quick poll (dan) 1m
24:00 - Live demo: baseline + speed/cost knobs (sofia) 12m
36:00 - Trigger simulated outage + automatic fallback (sofia) 6m
42:00 - How we measured & cost breakdown (lee) 5m
47:00 - Q&A (panel) 13m
```

maria: rehearsal plan: 2 dry runs (one tech-only, one full run-of-show). suggested slots: May 3 3pm PT (tech only), May 7 11am PT (full). Can folks confirm? :calendar:

sofia: confirm May 3 3pm for tech. May 7 tentative, ok to hold.

lee: ok May 3 for benchmark plug-in. May 7 good.

dan: confirmed May 7 11am PT for full run. I’ll create the calendar invites and gating checklist.

ops-bot: Staging cluster reserved Thu May 3 15:00 PT for 2 hours. Reminder will post 24h before.

maria: preflight checklist (short):
- slides uploaded to shared drive
- demo container image built + pinned
- telemetry dashboard link + sample metrics
- fallback model variant + routing policy ready
- rehearse scripted outage

dan: I’ll prod on slides + hub link. can someone paste the telemetry dashboard (metrics we’ll show)?

lee: will share a dashboard showing p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, CPU/GPU util, and cost per 1k tokens. I’ll attach sample numbers by EOD Monday.

sofia: demo prompts + a tiny dataset coming in this thread in a minute. also need white-listed IPs for live demo connection — ops to confirm.

maria: final ask: two headline messages for launch copy. quick drafts:
- "See how production teams keep LLM demos fast, cheap, and reliable — live failover included."
- "How to design LLM demos that scale: practical knobs, real metrics, and an ops-first playbook."
Feedback?

dan: both good. prefer the second as H1 and the first as subhead.

sofia: +1. also recommend a single CTA: "Reserve your spot" and a short form field for "primary constraint" to capture poll data.

maria: perfect. I’ll draft the registration page and copy this afternoon. tagging followups: @lee for benchmarks numbers, @sofia for demo prompts & IP whitelist, @dan for invites/moderation plan.

lee: will post numbers and the slide notes by Monday EOD.

sofia: demo prompts: "Summarize product doc", "Rewrite email", "Investigate logs" + 4 more test cases — posting now in drive link: https://rwd.infer/demo-cases

dan: thanks everyone — I’ll build invites and the poll in the webinar platform. running list of owners: slides/maria, benchmarks/lee, demo/sofia, host/dan.

maria: awesome — thanks team. will follow up with invites and a rehearsal checklist doc. :rocket:
